title: The Early Train (सुबह-दोपहर की जल्दी गाड़ी)

scenes.title: तीन घंटे पहले
scenes.summary: At twelve noon on Saturday, Hannah answers a telephone call from the station announcing that the retired mapmaker arrives at three in the afternoon instead of six.

scenes.title: ढाई बजे तक चार केक
scenes.summary: Hannah bursts into the café kitchen with the early-train news, and Tessa and Owen launch a high-speed relay to bake and cool four berry-and-almond cakes before three.

scenes.title: दूसरी और छठी चाबी बदलीं
scenes.summary: At the front desk, Graham proves from his paper ledger that Arthur accidentally handed Room 2's key to Room 6 and Room 6's key to Room 2 while wearing his glasses on his forehead.

scenes.title: पिट्ठू बैग और टोपी का बक्सा
scenes.summary: In the upstairs hallway, Evelyn steps out of Room 4 to help Hannah and Graham guide the swapped hallway bags to their proper doors with cheerful welcome cards.

scenes.title: एक पियानो पर चार हाथ
scenes.summary: Inside Room 9, Evelyn coaches Caleb through their joyful four-hand piano duet, helping the careful architect trade strict counting for warm musical flow.

scenes.title: छाँव में ठंडे होते साँचे
scenes.summary: At two-fifteen under the courtyard shade tree, Tessa, Owen, and Hannah cool the four golden cakes in the breeze and brush on the warm honey-orange glaze.

scenes.title: स्टेशन प्लेटफ़ॉर्म की ओर
scenes.summary: At half past two by the street gate, Hannah hands Caleb and Owen a compass-rose welcome card so the two brothers can greet the retired mapmaker at Central Station.

scenes.title: फाटक के बाहर कदमों की आहट
scenes.summary: At three sharp in the glowing courtyard, Arthur checks his glasses on his nose, Tessa sets hot mint tea on table one, and the gate bell rings twice as a taxi arrives.
